levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع

notes: The second «وحدثنيه» is a second isnad for the same saying (wording differs: «عضباء», «جنبه وظهره»): its own group, each route with its own names and its own «بهذا الإسناد»
«- يعني الدراوردي -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «وساق الحديث» means the matn is not written here
The earlier chain is not supplied (no previous report in context), so «بهذا الإسناد» stays a back_reference
